description: Source code implementing a list serialization format called 'listpack', including functions for creating, manipulating, encoding, decoding, and traversing listpack data structures. It references external files for memory management and assertions, and contains detailed encoding schemes for various integer and string types.

methods.name: lpNew
methods.description: Creates a new, empty listpack with specified capacity.

methods.name: lpFree
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a listpack.

methods.name: lpShrinkToFit
methods.description: Shrinks the listpack memory to fit its current size.

methods.name: lpGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a listpack element, decoding integer or string.

methods.name: lpGetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the listpack element as string or integer, populating output parameters.

methods.name: lpFind
methods.description: Finds an element matching a given string or integer, with skip parameter.

methods.name: lpInsert
methods.description: Inserts, deletes, or replaces an element at a specified position.

methods.name: lpNext
methods.description: Returns the next element in the listpack.

methods.name: lpPrev
methods.description: Returns the previous element in the listpack.

methods.name: lpFirst
methods.description: Returns the first element of the listpack.

methods.name: lpLast
methods.description: Returns the last element of the listpack.

methods.name: lpLength
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the listpack.
